claim_recommendations.rationale: The packet contains many fixed, generated, enumerated, and explicit export paths alongside generic path parameters. Retain only a narrow dynamic-path triage rule; static context does not establish caller control or containment.

Separate shell-string execution from argument-vector process launches. The former has confirmed unquoted interpolation and generic shell executors; the latter includes many fixed or intentional commands. Packet-only evidence cannot justify exploitability or blocking enforcement.
